name: Caring For Elderly Parents
overview: Scripture clearly commands honoring and respecting elderly parents as a vital expression of obedience to God, promising blessings and long life for those who do so, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Deuteronomy 5:16. The Lord calls His people to rise up before the aged and to honor them, recognizing the dignity and wisdom that come with old age (Leviticus 19:32). The Psalms express a heartfelt plea not to be forsaken in old age, emphasizing the need for compassionate care when strength fades (Psalms 71:9). Proverbs and Isaiah further instruct us to listen attentively to our parents even in their later years, underscoring the enduring value of their guidance and presence (Proverbs 23:22; Isaiah 46:3). Together, these verses reveal that caring for elderly parents is both a divine command and a reflection of reverence for God's design in family relationships.
